verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, an MCP server for AI tools, and SSO/SCIM for user accounts, but nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped, read-only, or otherwise least-privilege API keys for an agent. Adjacent items do not count toward this story: target-app scoping applies to feature gates rather than credentials, SCIM role provisioning covers human user accounts, and the Docs MCP server simply needs no key.
